issues.description: [suggestion] One-tap "Repeat meal" on the Nutrition diary — long-press or a small repeat-icon on any past meal card re-logs the same food(s)/quantities to today with one confirm tap, instead of requiring the CustomMealModal. Problem: athletes eat the same breakfast/post-workout shake most days but must reopen the manual-entry modal, hunt the food again via search or the buried "Recent meals" chip row (CustomMealModal.tsx:514-533), and resubmit every time — friction that discourages consistent logging (the exact behavior daily-completion/streak scoring depends on). Evidence: repo scan confirmed barcode scan, water tracker, and streak-freeze already exist, but no true repeat-log exists anywhere in src/pages/Nutrition.tsx or src/pages/_components/nutrition/ — the closest is the modal's prefill-only "Recent meals" row, which still requires opening the modal and resubmitting. Comparable trackers (MyFitnessPal "Copy meal", Cronometer "Copy from previous day") ship this as a core retention feature. v1 scope: add a repeat icon/swipe action on each meal-diary row (today or yesterday) that calls the existing add-meal/log endpoint with the same food_items + quantities, no new backend route needed; skip cross-day "copy whole day" for v1. Effort: ~0.5-1 day FE-only (new button + reuse existing log-meal service call).

issues.reviewReason: Root-caused — needs a product call before I touch it (streak logic drives all gamification XP/badges). The Profile '30-Day Challenge' ring reads current_streak from the nightly day-score engine (daily_report.py _evaluate_streak): a day counts toward the streak only if day_score >= 0.75, weighted calorie .30 / workout .25 / steps .20 / water .15 / logging .10. On your account right now: current_streak=0, longest_streak=0 (no day has ever qualified), and your recent daily reports (only 2026-07-12 and 07-14 exist — sparse) have day_score=NULL. TWO things make 0.75 hard to reach: (1) a day needs BROAD consistency — an accurate-calorie + workout + full-meal-logging day lands right at ~0.75-0.80, but a workout-only or meal-only day scores ~0.35-0.45 and never counts; (2) untracked WATER is scored 0.0 (penalty) while untracked STEPS is scored 0.5 (neutral) — an asymmetry that quietly drags most users below the bar, BUT the current tests explicitly lock water=0 when untracked, so that's intentional, not an accident. So the card is 'tracking' correctly per the current rules — it just rarely fires. Pick the intended behaviour and I'll implement + deploy: (A) make untracked water NEUTRAL (0.5) like steps — small, fairer, lifts the common meal+workout day comfortably over 0.75; (B) lower STREAK_THRESHOLD (e.g. 0.6) so a solid-but-not-perfect day counts; (C) redefine the 30-Day Challenge to count 'any day you logged something' (decouple from day_score) — most intuitive to a user who sees '0 of 30' despite using the app; or (D) combination. Recommend A+C. Also flagging that day_score is persisting as NULL on your reports — I'll confirm whether the score is being stored on generation once you pick a direction. (I can't verify a streak-engine change end-to-end from the headless QA account — it has no rich multi-day logs — so I'm not shipping a blind gamification-wide change without your call.)
